response.overview: Sixteen-year-old Diya, a quiet and isolated girl carrying the weight of trauma, finds an unexpected connection with Viren, a reckless boy struggling with violence in his own home. What begins as bullying slowly transforms into a fragile friendship as the two discover comfort in each other and realise they are both fighting battles no one else can see.  But when Viren is forced to choose between the acceptance of his friends and the girl who has come to trust him, one cruel decision leaves him with an apology he never gets the chance to give.  Black Bird is an emotional coming-of-age drama about friendship, trauma, guilt, and the devastating consequences of the things left unsaid.
response.title: Black Bird
